name: assetcredits-simple
description: Simple ladder for the assetCredits flag (tier:'simple', default true — universal, shown in both modes): the 'Asset credits' entry in the Appearance popover gates on this flag (CreditsModal itself has no flag check of its own). Verifies the button's presence in Simple + Pro, a real open round-trip (popover -> click -> CreditsModal shows 'Asset credits' title + fetched CREDITS.json sections), and that setFeatureFlag(false) hides only the entry point.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-credits-button-present-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Asset credits'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Asset credits button not found in Simple mode (assetCredits is tier:simple, default true)'); })()

steps.name: verify-credits-button-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Asset credits'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Asset credits button not found in Pro mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-credits-button-hidden
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Asset credits'); if (btn) throw new Error('Asset credits button still present after setFeatureFlag(assetCredits,false)'); })()

steps.name: verify-credits-button-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Asset credits'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Asset credits button did not come back after restoring the flag'); })()
